section_summary.extract_value: The introduction defines creativity and discusses the genetic and environmental influences on creative achievement, utilizing the classical twin design. It reviews prior research, including studies by Roeling et al. (2017), Piffer and Hur (2014) which used twin samples and the CAQ, and Kandler et al. (2016) on creativity measures. The section also explores cognitive abilities (intelligence, creative potential) and personality (openness) as correlates of creative achievement. The authors then introduce their own research (Study X), which aims to investigate genetic and environmental influences on associations between cognitive abilities, personality, and creative achievement across artistic and scientific domains using the STAGE twin cohort and CAQ.
